envelope.description: Decide what to park: refusals, run selection and checkpoint assembly

body.title: Decide what to park: refusals, run selection and checkpoint assembly
body.summary: Add parkPlan(repo, unit, opts) in src/workflow/team/handoff.ts: refuse when the actor holds the unit, the unit is a Task, there is no issue or holder, there is nothing to park, the supplied token belongs to another unit, another actor or no owner, or the branch name is invalid; otherwise choose the actor's most recently touched owned run (or only the draft), and assemble the run or draft-only checkpoint with the owner, the upstream snapshot, the repository identity (root commit id) and the artifact paths. No git command that changes anything runs here.
acceptanceChecks: Every park refusal in the LLD's error paths returns ok:false with its reason and writes nothing
With an owned live run the plan is a run checkpoint carrying the owner, the upstream snapshot and the repository identity; with only an uncommitted draft it is a draft-only checkpoint
With two owned runs for the unit the most recently touched one is chosen and its run id is named

tests.name: src/workflow/team/__tests__/handoff-park-plan.test.ts: parkPlan refuses when the actor holds the unit, for a Task, with no issue or holder, with nothing to park, and for a supplied token of another unit, actor or no owner, and assembles a run or draft-only checkpoint otherwise
